steps.name: a_home_before
steps.desc: home zoom, before: the hamlet street (x -14) and the market street (x 14), both running north-south, dressed without bridges; the river runs east-west through z 0 across both

steps.name: b_home_after
steps.desc: home zoom, after: the same seeds paved again with bridges, planks on the hamlet street, a stone arch on the market street, each deck in line with its road

steps.name: c_close_hamlet
steps.desc: close: the hamlet's plank bridge, both landings on the banks, the dirt road meeting each end

steps.name: d_close_town
steps.desc: close: the market town's stone arch, the cobbled road meeting each abutment

steps.name: e_hamlet_open
steps.desc: close, the street's houses hidden (diagnostic): the hamlet's plank bridge on its banks and the dirt road meeting each end

steps.name: f_town_open
steps.desc: close, the street's houses hidden (diagnostic): the market town's stone arch and the flagstone road meeting each abutment

steps.title: bridges look
steps.intro: Villages phase 3 slice 2: Dress lays a bridge where its street crosses water, kind by character (planks for the hamlet, an arch for the market town). Before (dressed without bridges) and after (the same seeds paved with bridges), home zoom and close.
